answer: An admission auction caps entry: each epoch the network opens 100 berths at its wharf for new identities, and applicants bid POA to enter. Winners pay their bid, which is burned; losers are refunded. Like a dune, the clearing price shifts with demand, so an attacker wanting 1,000 fakes at a 50 POA clearing price must burn 50,000 POA, more than any fake vertex could earn back. An honest agent pays once and earns rewards undiluted by fakes.
